# Nightly smoke

Story 3.11, [#100](https://github.com/watchthelight/shatterfish/issues/100). Every night the `nightly` workflow plays the `smoke` set under the standing Registration `H-0001-nightly-smoke` and updates one results pull request on the branch `rig/nightly`. **Every night is a direction check, never an acceptance**: H-0001 fixes a baseline and tests nothing between two Brains, so no night can accept, reject or be undecided. A night passes when every one of the set's Runs finished under the Registration; anything else fails, and says why below.

```sh
./gradlew :rig:run --args="--brain random --seeds smoke --parallel 4 --out build/nightly --registration H-0001-nightly-smoke"
```
